summary_en: Terra to acquire Satudora Holdings via public tender offer at ¥1,220/share. Tender period 22 June – 3 Aug 2026 (30 business days). Target acquisition 8,805,475 shares (lower threshold 4,165,800 shares). Settlement 10 August 2026.
title_en: Notice of Commencement of Public Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of Satudora Holdings Co., Ltd. (Code: 3544) by Terra Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: Terra Co., Ltd., announced on 19 June 2026 the commencement of a public tender offer to acquire ordinary shares of Satudora Holdings Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard, ticker 3544). The tender offer opens on 22 June 2026 and closes on 3 August 2026 (30 business days). The purchase price is ¥1,220 per share. Terra has set a target acquisition volume of 8,805,475 shares, with a lower threshold of 4,165,800 shares and no stated upper limit. Settlement is scheduled for 10 August 2026. The offer is filed under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act at the request of the target company.
